message.reasoning:
I have a good picture. Let me summarize the project.

Let me check a couple more things: the fork nature (opensensor/vllm-ascend is a fork of vllm-project/vllm-ascend), and the 310P focus.

Let me verify the upstream relationship.

function.name: bash
function.arguments: {"command":"git log --oneline --format='%s' --all --grep=\"merge upstream\" -i | head -5; echo \"---\"; git log --oneline --format='%s' --all --grep=\"sync\" -i | head -8","description":"Check upstream sync cadence"}

function.arguments: {"command":"cat .gitmodules; echo \"===VERSION===\"; grep -rn \"version\" setup.py | grep -i \"scm\\|fallback\" | head -5","description":"Check submodules and versioning"}
